purpose: Run the first out-of-sample sign-percolation test on fresh graph-reachability contexts around the locally rank-four Qwen0.8B nodes, with one unquantized float16 layer control.
claim_boundary: This fresh development-model capture may establish context-restricted lineage, an out-of-sample first Stiefel-Whitney sign result, and a q=0 percolation phase on the frozen base-to-naive grid. It cannot establish semantic identity, causal edit value, VPD efficacy, capability preservation, compactification, recursive improvement, or RSI. Float16 is an unquantized full-weight control, not float32 arithmetic.

prior_node_selection.selection_role: Sites, behavior family, and two context neighborhoods were selected from the revealed dense-local run; every prompt and activation measured here is fresh. This is confirmatory only for the registered conditional predictions, not for the site-selection process itself.

state_axis_interpretation: Engineering checkpoint axis only; the naive adapter is not an efficacy comparator.

precision_control.interpretation: Unquantized float16 model weights and float32-stored activations. This tests four-bit sensitivity at one layer and is not a float32 model capture.

prompt_design.neighborhood_semantics: The labels preserve the preregistered old-context targeting, while every graph instance and opaque nonce is freshly generated. The two replicas per neighborhood are not byte or activation reuses.

primary_object.rank_selection: Largest prefix rank passing the strict bootstrap-versus-label-permutation margin at every state x fresh-context node in one site grid.

graph.edges: adjacent fresh context shards within each state plus same-shard cross-state edges

holonomy.orientation_reversal: Categorical sign -1; canonical angles remain suppressed.

w1_gate.rule: Every admitted fundamental generator loop has det(H)>0 on geometry_validation, construction/validation determinant agreement, and a one-sided 95% Clopper-Pearson upper bound at most 0.05 on its bootstrap orientation-reversal probability.

percolation_gate.rule: At least one main-capture site is connected with beta_1>0 and is classified coherent by the exact Experiment-07 phase classifier; every admitted generator at every counted site must pass the w1 gate.
percolation_gate.synthetic_comparison: Use the identical L=2, C=4 graph size and exact phase classifier. Synthetic agreement is calibration of the label, not evidence that the transformer was drawn from the synthetic ensemble.

precision_gate.rule: Layer 19 must have at least one loop admitted in both four-bit and float16 analyses; all common admitted loop determinant signs agree and both q=0 phase labels are coherent.
precision_gate.failure_effect: The main four-bit result remains reportable, but precision_stable is false and no precision-robust claim is allowed.
